metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based product streams for the General Listings Marketplace domain, covering buyer discovery, seller tooling, monetization, and trust.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each experience now carries only experience-specific flows. Each flow step lists the bricks and external systems used inside that experience.

rootGroups.name: Buyer Journey
rootGroups.description: How local buyers discover relevant listings, save and return to intent, and contact sellers with confidence.

streams.name: Browse Interesting Listings
streams.description: Help buyers enter the marketplace and quickly find listings worth exploring. Serves Local Buyer (cg1) job jtbd-cg1-1; primary KPI: Successful buyer transaction rate (top-of-funnel via Discovery efficiency). Lead team: Buyer Engagement & Web Shell; supporting teams: Buyer Discovery Intelligence, Experience Platform - Frontend Core.

flows.title: Browse Interesting Listings
flows.description: Help buyers enter the marketplace and quickly find listings worth exploring.

steps.title: Open marketplace home
keyFacts: The home surface must lead with fresh local supply for the buyer's city and last-viewed categories, not generic national inventory.
First impression of liquidity is set in seconds: a sparse or stale local feed signals the marketplace has nothing for this buyer.
painPoints: Buyers in thinner metros or categories land on stale or out-of-area listings and assume the marketplace is dead.
Anonymous first sessions have no location or intent signal, so the home feed defaults to low-relevance national filler.

dependencies.description: Marketplace homepage and landing experience: serves marketing content and personalized entry points into search, categories, and listing detail pages.
dependencies.how: Uses Homepage to lead buyers from the landing experience into search, categories, and listings in open marketplace home.

dependencies.name: Classifieds Recommendations
dependencies.description: Ability to match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations (match classified & seeker)
dependencies.how: Uses Classifieds Recommendations for match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations in open marketplace home.

steps.title: Browse category feed
keyFacts: Category feeds mix recommerce goods, dealer motors, and agency real estate that each need different sort logic and trust cues.
Recency and distance matter more than absolute relevance in classifieds: a perfect match 300 km away is useless to a pickup buyer.
painPoints: Duplicate and re-posted listings from sellers gaming freshness clutter the feed and bury genuine new supply.
Expired or already-sold items left live make the category look fuller than it is and waste buyer clicks.

dependencies.name: Classifieds Recommendations
dependencies.description: Ability to match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations (match classified & seeker)
dependencies.how: Uses Classifieds Recommendations for match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations in browse category feed.

steps.title: See personalized recommendations
keyFacts: Recommendations have to respect that most classifieds intent is single-item and short-lived: a sofa bought last week should not keep being recommended.
Cross-category recommerce signals (someone browsing phones may want accessories) only work when local supply for the adjacent category exists.
painPoints: Recommending listings that get moderated or pulled minutes later breaks buyer trust in the suggestions.
Cold-start buyers with no history get generic bestsellers that ignore their location and price band.

dependencies.name: Classifieds Recommendations
dependencies.description: Ability to match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations (match classified & seeker)
dependencies.how: Uses Classifieds Recommendations for match published classifieds with seekers' saved search criteria and provide recommendations in see personalized recommendations.

steps.title: Open promising listing
keyFacts: The first detail-page open is the relevant-detail-view signal that feeds the buyer's discovery-efficiency KPI branch.
Buyers scan photos, price, distance, and seller credibility together before deciding the listing is worth a message.
painPoints: Thin listings (one blurry photo, no description) force buyers back to the feed and waste the click.
A promising thumbnail that opens onto a price-bait or wrong-category listing erodes trust in the whole feed.

streams.name: Search, Save, and Return
streams.description: Help buyers narrow choices, save intent, and come back to relevant inventory later. Serves Local Buyer (cg1) jobs jtbd-cg1-1/jtbd-cg1-2; primary KPI: Successful buyer transaction rate (via Alert precision and repeat return). Lead team: Buyer Growth - Discovery; supporting teams: Buyer Discovery Intelligence, Experience Services Platform, Market Intelligence & Pricing.
outcomes: Faster path back to relevant listings

flows.title: Search, Save, and Return
flows.description: Help buyers narrow choices, save intent, and come back to relevant inventory later.

steps.title: Run search
keyFacts: Free-text classifieds queries are noisy (brand misspellings, local slang, model numbers) and must be normalized against the category taxonomy.
Geo radius is part of the query: results have to be ranked by distance-and-recency, not just text match.
painPoints: A query with zero fresh local matches returns an empty or far-away result set and the buyer leaves without saving anything.
Motors and real-estate searches need structured attribute filters that a goods-style keyword search handles poorly.

dependencies.name: Search Engine Results Page (SERP)
dependencies.description: Ability to search for classifieds through diverse criteria (by location, price range, amenities, on map...)
dependencies.how: Uses Search Engine Results Page (SERP) for search for classifieds through diverse criteria in run search.

dependencies.name: Saved Search / Alerts
dependencies.description: Alert consumers about new classifieds - email / mobile push
dependencies.how: Uses Saved Search / Alerts for alert consumers about new classifieds - email / mobile push in run search.

dependencies.name: Search and Messaging Infrastructure
dependencies.description: Support indexing and alert delivery.
dependencies.how: Relies on Search and Messaging Infrastructure for indexing and alert delivery in run search.

steps.title: Apply filters
keyFacts: Filter facets are category-specific: mileage and fuel for motors, m2 and rooms for real estate, condition and shipping for goods.
Filters only help if sellers populated the structured attributes, so coverage depends on listing quality upstream.
painPoints: Sellers who skip optional attributes drop out of filtered result sets even when their item matches, shrinking perceived supply.
Over-narrowing filters in a thin local market collapses the result set to zero and pushes the buyer to abandon.

dependencies.name: Notification Service
dependencies.description: Ability to send notifications with user preferences (via Email, Push, ...)
dependencies.how: Uses Notification Service for send notifications with user preferences in apply filters.

steps.title: Save search intent
keyFacts: Saving a search converts a fleeting query into a standing demand signal that also feeds sellers' demand heatmaps.
Most high-value classifieds purchases are considered over days, so capturing intent for later is where conversion is won.
painPoints: Buyers won't save a search if the current result set is empty, so thin supply suppresses the very signal that would fix it.
Saved searches that were too broad later flood the buyer with irrelevant alerts and get muted.

dependencies.name: Saved Search / Alerts
dependencies.description: Alert consumers about new classifieds - email / mobile push
dependencies.how: Uses Saved Search / Alerts for alert consumers about new classifieds - email / mobile push in save search intent.

dependencies.name: Search and Messaging Infrastructure
dependencies.description: Support indexing and alert delivery.
dependencies.how: Relies on Search and Messaging Infrastructure for indexing and alert delivery in save search intent.

steps.title: Return through alert or notification
keyFacts: Alert speed is the differentiator: for in-demand local goods the first buyer to message usually wins, so minutes matter.
Alert precision (share of alerts that trigger a real action) is the buyer's measured discovery-efficiency KPI.
painPoints: Alerts that fire after the item is already sold or moderated out send buyers to dead listings and train them to ignore notifications.
Batching or delayed indexing means the alert arrives hours late, by which point local supply has already been claimed.

streams.name: Contact Sellers Confidently
streams.description: Help buyers evaluate a listing and start a trusted conversation or transaction. Serves Local Buyer (cg1) job jtbd-cg1-2; primary KPI: Successful buyer transaction rate (contact-to-trusted-action conversion). Lead team: Buyer Growth - Discovery; supporting teams: Experience Services Platform, Identity & Trust Platform, Identity Verification & Account Platform.

flows.title: Contact Sellers Confidently
flows.description: Help buyers evaluate a listing and start a trusted conversation or transaction.

steps.title: Read listing details
keyFacts: The detail page must surface seller credibility (verified badge, reviews, account age) alongside the item so the buyer can judge trust before messaging.
For motors and real estate the page is a lead-generation surface; for shippable goods it is the entry point to protected payment.
painPoints: Listings with no seller history or unverified contact details make buyers hesitate, especially on high-value items.
Classic scam patterns (below-market price, off-platform contact requests in the description) reach the buyer here if not filtered.

dependencies.description: Ability to show a detailed page of a selected classified (description, images, merchant contact information...)
dependencies.how: Uses Classified Details Page (CDP) for show a detailed page of a selected classified in read listing details.

dependencies.name: Consumer Contacting Management
dependencies.description: Provides a single, safe contact experience for buyers to reach private and professional sellers, keeping the conversation on-platform.
dependencies.how: Uses Consumer Contacting Management to give the buyer a single, safe on-platform way to reach the seller in read listing details.

steps.title: Shortlist option
keyFacts: Buyers comparison-shop within a category, so favouriting several listings before contacting any is the normal classifieds pattern.
A shortlist is a soft commitment that the marketplace can re-engage with price-drop or still-available nudges.
painPoints: Shortlisted items that sell or expire without notice leave the buyer comparing against dead options.
Without sold/expired state on the favourite, buyers waste effort re-contacting sellers of unavailable items.

dependencies.name: Consumer Contacting Management
dependencies.description: Provides a single, safe contact experience for buyers to reach private and professional sellers, keeping the conversation on-platform.
dependencies.how: Uses Consumer Contacting Management to give the buyer a single, safe on-platform way to reach the seller in shortlist option.

steps.title: Start seller conversation
keyFacts: On-platform messaging keeps the lead inside the marketplace and gives anti-fraud a window to screen scam patterns before contact details are exposed.
The contact moment is the buyer-to-seller conversion that the Successful buyer transaction rate KPI hinges on.
painPoints: Sellers who go silent or are slow to reply lose the buyer to a competing local listing within hours.
Scammers steer buyers off-platform (WhatsApp, email) to evade protection, leaking the lead and the safety net.

dependencies.name: Consumer Contacting Management
dependencies.description: Provides a single, safe contact experience for buyers to reach private and professional sellers, keeping the conversation on-platform.
dependencies.how: Uses Consumer Contacting Management to give the buyer a single, safe on-platform way to reach the seller in start seller conversation.

steps.title: Take next trusted action
keyFacts: The trusted next action branches by category: arrange cash-on-pickup for local goods, enter protected payment for shippable goods, or hand a qualified lead to a dealer/agency.
Most classifieds value still settles off-platform, so the marketplace optimizes for a safe handoff rather than forcing checkout everywhere.
painPoints: Pushing protected payment into categories where pickup is the norm (motors, real estate) adds friction and suppresses contact.
When the handoff goes off-platform the marketplace loses visibility into whether the transaction succeeded, weakening trust signals.

rootGroups.name: Private Seller Journey
rootGroups.description: How casual household sellers publish a quality listing fast, price it with confidence, and manage it through to a sale.

streams.name: Publish a Good Listing Fast
streams.description: Help a private seller create and enrich a listing quickly without sacrificing quality. Serves Casual Seller (cg2) job jtbd-cg2-1; primary KPI: Listing-to-sale realization (via Publish completion rate and listing quality). Lead team: Seller Growth - Listing Funnel; supporting teams: Seller Success Experience, Market Intelligence & Pricing.

flows.title: Publish a Good Listing Fast
flows.description: Help a private seller create and enrich a listing quickly without sacrificing quality.

steps.title: Start listing flow
keyFacts: Choosing the right category up front drives which attributes, fees, and operating model (goods vs motors vs real estate) the rest of the funnel applies.
Casual household sellers list rarely, so the funnel cannot assume any prior knowledge of marketplace conventions.
painPoints: Sellers pick the wrong category and end up in the wrong taxonomy, hurting discoverability and triggering moderation reclassification.
An onboarding wall (forced account creation, identity steps) before the seller sees value kills the listing start.

dependencies.name: Seller Listing Funnel
dependencies.description: Guided self-serve flow that turns a casual seller's item, photos, and category inputs into a high-quality marketplace listing.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Listing Funnel for guided self-serve flow that turns a casual seller's item, photos, and category inputs into a high-quality marketplace listing in start listing flow.

dependencies.name: Category Content Creation
dependencies.description: Producing useful category, trust, and marketplace content that helps buyers and sellers make better local commerce decisions.
dependencies.how: Uses Category Content Creation for producing useful category, trust, and marketplace content that helps buyers and sellers make better local commerce decisions in start listing flow.

dependencies.name: Media Processing Services
dependencies.description: Support media uploads and transformations.
dependencies.how: Relies on Media Processing Services for media uploads and transformations in start listing flow.

steps.title: Add listing details
keyFacts: Title, description, and structured attributes are what make the listing findable in search and filters later, so detail quality is liquidity.
Smart defaults and attribute suggestions cut effort while still capturing the fields buyers filter on.
painPoints: Asking a casual seller for too many fields up front causes mid-funnel drop-off and lowers publish completion.
Sparse or vague descriptions produce a low-quality listing that ranks poorly and stays unsold.

dependencies.name: Seller Listing Funnel
dependencies.description: Guided self-serve flow that turns a casual seller's item, photos, and category inputs into a high-quality marketplace listing.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Listing Funnel for guided self-serve flow that turns a casual seller's item, photos, and category inputs into a high-quality marketplace listing in add listing details.

steps.title: Upload media
keyFacts: Photos are the single strongest driver of contact in classifieds, so the funnel pushes multiple clear images per item.
Uploaded media passes virus scan, duplicate/stock-image detection, and CDN distribution before going live.
painPoints: Mobile uploads over weak connections stall or fail, and a half-uploaded gallery makes the seller abandon.
Reused stock or stolen photos flag the listing for moderation, delaying or blocking publication.

dependencies.name: Media Management
dependencies.description: Ability to manage (create, store, and distribute) media (images, videos) for all the actors (including services such as virus scan, and global distribution via CDNs)
dependencies.how: Uses Media Management to store, scan, and distribute the seller's uploaded photos via CDN in upload media.

dependencies.name: Media Processing Services
dependencies.description: Support media uploads and transformations.
dependencies.how: Relies on Media Processing Services for media uploads and transformations in upload media.

steps.title: Publish listing
keyFacts: Publish runs the listing through automated policy and quality moderation before it becomes visible and counts toward published supply.
This is where any insertion or category fee and optional paid-promotion upsell are presented to the seller.
painPoints: A moderation reject with an unclear reason leaves the casual seller stuck and unsure how to fix the listing.
Prohibited-item or duplicate-listing rejections at the final step waste all the seller's prior effort and risk abandonment.

streams.name: Price with Confidence
streams.description: Help a seller understand market signals and choose a more effective listing price. Serves Casual Seller (cg2) job jtbd-cg2-1; primary KPI: Listing-to-sale realization (via Price-fit confidence). Lead team: Market Intelligence & Pricing; supporting teams: Seller Success Experience, Geo, Catalog & Tracking Data.

flows.title: Price with Confidence
flows.description: Help a seller understand market signals and choose a more effective listing price.

steps.title: Review price suggestions
keyFacts: Price guidance is derived from comparable local sold and active listings in the same category and condition band, not a national average.
Price-fit confidence is a measured seller KPI: a credible suggested range is what makes the seller list at a sellable price.
painPoints: Thin comparable data in a small metro or niche category produces a wide, low-confidence range the seller can't act on.
Sellers anchored to what they originally paid distrust a market suggestion that comes in lower.

dependencies.name: Pricing Guidance Page
dependencies.description: A page with a visualization of average listing prices per geographic location (from the region down to the exact address)
dependencies.how: Uses Pricing Guidance Page for a page with a visualization of average listing prices per geographic location in review price suggestions.

dependencies.name: Pricing Guidance Engine
dependencies.description: Pricing and demand-signal engine that helps professional sellers price inventory, understand category dynamics, and improve conversion.
dependencies.how: Uses Pricing Guidance Engine for pricing and demand-signal engine that helps professional sellers price inventory, understand category dynamics, and improve conversion in review price suggestions.

steps.title: Compare market examples
keyFacts: Showing real comparable listings (and where demand is concentrated via the heatmap) is more persuasive than an abstract number.
Demand context tells the seller whether to price for a fast sale or hold for a higher offer in their area.
painPoints: Comparables polluted by stale, mispriced, or already-sold listings give a distorted reference point.
Without local demand signal the seller can't tell if a slow sale is a price problem or just thin local interest.

dependencies.name: Demand Heatmap
dependencies.description: Providing professional sellers with a demand heatmap based on search, lead, and inventory signals so they can understand where buyer demand is concentrated.
dependencies.how: Uses Demand Heatmap for providing professional sellers with a demand heatmap based on search, lead, and inventory signals so they can understand where buyer demand is concentrated in compare market examples.

steps.title: Adjust asking price
keyFacts: Re-pricing a live listing should re-rank it and can trigger price-drop alerts to buyers who shortlisted it.
Iterative price adjustment is how casual sellers find the market when their first guess was off.
painPoints: Frequent small drops without effect leave the seller unsure whether price or low local demand is the blocker.
A re-price that resets the listing's age or visibility unfairly can cost the seller hard-won ranking.

dependencies.name: Pricing Guidance Page
dependencies.description: A page with a visualization of average listing prices per geographic location (from the region down to the exact address)
dependencies.how: Uses Pricing Guidance Page for a page with a visualization of average listing prices per geographic location in adjust asking price.

steps.title: Confirm pricing decision
keyFacts: Confirming the price commits the listing to market and the engine can offer a promotion bump to accelerate sale at the chosen price.
A price within the suggested range is the leading indicator the engine ties to listing-to-sale realization.
painPoints: Sellers who confirm well above guidance get few contacts and the listing goes stale, hurting realization.
If the confirmed price isn't reflected immediately across search, cache, and alerts, buyers see inconsistent numbers.

streams.name: Manage Live Listings
streams.description: Help a seller update inventory, manage visibility, and follow up after publication. Serves Casual Seller (cg2) job jtbd-cg2-2; primary KPI: Listing-to-sale realization (via listing freshness and buyer response). Lead team: Seller Success Experience; supporting teams: Casual Seller Transactions & Reputation, Payments & Transactions.

flows.title: Manage Live Listings
flows.description: Help a seller update inventory, manage visibility, and follow up after publication.

steps.title: Edit live listing
keyFacts: Editing a live listing (fix a typo, add a photo, correct a spec) re-submits it through moderation before changes go live.
Sellers expect edits to keep the listing's accumulated views and ranking rather than starting it over.
painPoints: An edit that re-triggers moderation can briefly take the listing offline at exactly the wrong moment.
Material edits used to disguise a different item (bait-and-switch) must be caught, which adds friction for honest sellers.

dependencies.name: Seller Listings Management
dependencies.description: Management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Listings Management for management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal in edit live listing.

dependencies.name: Seller Inventory Workspace
dependencies.description: Workspace where logged-in sellers can review their active listings, drafts, sold items, and performance signals.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Inventory Workspace for workspace where logged-in sellers can review their active listings, drafts, sold items, and performance signals in edit live listing.

steps.title: Refresh availability
keyFacts: Bumping or refreshing a listing restores its position in the recency-weighted feed and is a core paid-promotion lever.
Keeping availability accurate (still for sale, reserved, sold) is what protects buyer trust in the supply they see.
painPoints: Sellers who never mark items sold leave zombie listings live, inflating apparent supply and frustrating buyers.
Abusing free refresh to game freshness floods the feed and forces ranking penalties that catch honest sellers too.

dependencies.name: Seller Listings Management
dependencies.description: Management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Listings Management for management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal in refresh availability.

steps.title: Respond to activity
keyFacts: Fast replies to buyer messages are the strongest predictor of a casual seller actually completing a sale.
The workspace has to triage genuine buyers from lowballers, time-wasters, and scam messages targeting sellers.
painPoints: Casual sellers check the app infrequently, so without push nudges buyer messages go cold and the sale is lost.
Scam messages to sellers (fake-payment, courier-fee schemes) erode trust if not flagged in the inbox.

dependencies.name: Seller Listings Management
dependencies.description: Management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal.
dependencies.how: Uses Seller Listings Management for management space for casual seller listings created through self-serve posting inside the consumer portal in respond to activity.

steps.title: Pause or end listing
keyFacts: Marking sold is the explicit listing-to-sale outcome that closes the loop and feeds the seller's realization KPI.
Capturing whether it sold on-platform, off-platform, or was withdrawn improves future supply and pricing signals.
painPoints: If ending a listing is buried, sellers abandon stale items instead of closing them, polluting live supply.
No sold-price capture on off-platform deals leaves a blind spot in pricing intelligence for the next seller.

rootGroups.name: Professional Seller Journey
rootGroups.description: How dealers, agencies, and storefronts run their business at scale and turn marketplace visibility into qualified leads.

streams.name: Run a Storefront
streams.description: Help professional sellers represent their business and manage storefront operations at scale. Serves Professional Merchant (cg3) job jtbd-cg3-1; primary KPI: Qualified demand yield (via Operational reliability / feed success). Inventory sync also relies on Merchant SaaS/Feed Partner (cg4-p2, jtbd-cg4-1). Lead team: Professional Seller & Storefront Platform; supporting teams: Intermediary & Directory Management, Merchant CRM & Contracts, Pro Tools & Seller Intelligence.

flows.title: Run a Storefront
flows.description: Help professional sellers represent their business and manage storefront operations at scale.

steps.title: Set up storefront
keyFacts: Professional onboarding requires business identity and legal-entity verification (VAT/registration) that casual sellers never face.
The storefront entity becomes the source of truth that ties inventory, leads, subscription, and team permissions together.
painPoints: Multi-location dealers and agencies have complex entity hierarchies that a flat storefront model represents poorly.
Slow business verification or document KYC delays go-live and stalls the dealer's first paid inventory.

dependencies.name: Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Entity SSoT
dependencies.description: Single source of truth for professional seller accounts, legal entities, storefront structures, and permissions.
dependencies.how: Uses Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Entity SSoT for single source of truth for professional seller accounts, legal entities, storefront structures, and permissions in set up storefront.

dependencies.name: Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Members Management
dependencies.description: Manages members, roles, and permissions within professional seller organizations.
dependencies.how: Uses Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Members Management to manage members, roles, and permissions across the storefront in set up storefront.

steps.title: Manage business profile
keyFacts: The public storefront page (profile, reputation, opening hours, full live inventory) is a dealer's branded shopfront and a buyer trust signal.
Profile completeness and review volume directly influence how buyers weigh a professional listing against a private one.
painPoints: A thin or out-of-date storefront undercuts the credibility advantage a dealer pays a subscription for.
Reputation damage from a few unresolved disputes is highly visible on the public profile and suppresses leads.

dependencies.name: Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Profile & Directory
dependencies.description: A stream with two sides: a management page for professional sellers and a public storefront page showing merchant profile, reputation, contact information, and live inventory.
dependencies.how: Uses Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Profile & Directory for a stream with two sides: a management page for professional sellers and a public storefront page showing merchant profile, reputation, contact information, and live inventory in manage business profile.

steps.title: Sync inventory
keyFacts: Dealers and agencies push catalog from their own DMS/CRM via feed or partner API rather than listing items one by one.
Feed success rate (updates processed without critical errors) is the dealer's measured operational-reliability KPI.
painPoints: A malformed or schema-drifted feed fails validation and silently leaves stale or missing inventory live.
Mapping the partner's free-form attributes to the marketplace taxonomy is error-prone and a top source of moderation rejects.

dependencies.name: Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Profile & Directory
dependencies.description: A stream with two sides: a management page for professional sellers and a public storefront page showing merchant profile, reputation, contact information, and live inventory.
dependencies.how: Uses Professional Seller / Dealer / Storefront Profile & Directory for a stream with two sides: a management page for professional sellers and a public storefront page showing merchant profile, reputation, contact information, and live inventory in sync inventory.

dependencies.name: CRM and Inventory Platforms
dependencies.description: Provide operational data for pro-seller synchronization.
dependencies.how: Relies on CRM and Inventory Platforms for operational data for pro-seller synchronization in sync inventory.

steps.title: Maintain storefront team access
keyFacts: Dealerships and agencies need role-based access so multiple agents share one storefront without overwriting each other.
Lead routing and performance attribution depend on knowing which agent owns which listing and conversation.
painPoints: Staff turnover leaves orphaned listings and active leads tied to departed agents if access isn't reassigned.
Over-broad permissions let any agent edit or delete shared inventory, creating accidental supply loss.

streams.name: Manage Demand and Leads
streams.description: Help professional sellers optimize visibility and respond to the right leads faster. Serves Professional Merchant (cg3) job jtbd-cg3-2; primary KPI: Qualified demand yield (via lead quality and response speed in motors/real-estate lead generation). Lead team: Professional Seller & Storefront Platform; supporting teams: Lead Inbox & Seller Operations, Lead Scoring, Matching & Inventory Workspace, Pro Tools & Seller Intelligence.

flows.title: Manage Demand and Leads
flows.description: Help professional sellers optimize visibility and respond to the right leads faster.

steps.title: Review demand signals
keyFacts: Demand heatmaps tell a dealer which models, price bands, and locations are getting buyer search and lead volume right now.
These signals drive where the dealer spends paid-promotion budget to lift qualified demand yield.
painPoints: Demand data lagging by days leads dealers to promote inventory whose buyer interest has already moved on.
Aggregate signals without category or geo granularity are too coarse for a multi-location dealer to act on.

steps.title: Prioritize incoming leads
keyFacts: In motors and real estate the product is the lead, not an on-platform sale, so lead quality and speed-to-contact define value.
The leads inbox aggregates messages, callbacks, and form fills from many listings into one queue to triage.
painPoints: High-intent leads sit behind tyre-kickers and duplicate inquiries when there's no scoring or de-duplication.
Leads that slip past SLA windows go cold, directly lowering the dealer's qualified demand yield.

steps.title: Assign lead to agent
keyFacts: Lead-to-agent matching routes each inquiry to the agent best placed by location, specialism, or current load to close it.
Clear ownership lets the dealer attribute conversions and hold agents to response SLAs.
painPoints: Round-robin assignment that ignores agent expertise or availability sends leads to someone who can't act on them.
Leads that fall between agents (no clear owner) leak entirely and never get a reply.

steps.title: Track listing performance
keyFacts: Per-listing impressions, contacts, and lead-conversion let a dealer see which inventory and which promotions actually pay back.
Performance data closes the loop on paid visibility spend so budget shifts to what yields qualified demand.
painPoints: Vanity view counts without contact and lead-conversion context mislead dealers into over-promoting weak inventory.
Without attribution from promotion spend to leads, dealers can't tell whether paid visibility is profitable.

rootGroups.name: Trust and Monetization
rootGroups.description: How the marketplace keeps transactions safe and turns liquidity into revenue through protection, payments, and paid visibility.

streams.name: Transact on a Trusted Marketplace
streams.description: Help buyers and sellers complete higher-trust interactions with better payments and protection. Serves Local Buyer (cg1, jtbd-cg1-2) and Casual Seller (cg2, jtbd-cg2-2) in shippable goods/recommerce; primary KPI: Successful buyer transaction rate (protected-payment completion and fraud exposure). Lead team: Payments & Transactions; supporting teams: Identity & Trust Platform, Identity Verification & Account Platform.

flows.title: Transact on a Trusted Marketplace
flows.description: Help buyers and sellers complete higher-trust interactions with better payments and protection.

steps.title: Verify counterpart identity
keyFacts: Identity verification is risk-tiered: light-touch for low-value goods, stronger KYC where protected payment or high value is involved.
A visible verified badge raises buyer confidence and is a precondition for opening protected payment.
painPoints: Heavy verification on a low-value pickup deal adds friction that drives both sides off-platform.
Fraudsters cycle through fresh or stolen identities, so one-time verification alone doesn't stop repeat scam accounts.

dependencies.name: Fraud Detection
dependencies.description: Ability to automatically censor a classified
dependencies.how: Uses Fraud Detection for automatically censor a classified in verify counterpart identity.

dependencies.name: Identity Verification
dependencies.description: Ability to certify the identity of an actor via validation of a certification file (actor validation via certification file)
dependencies.how: Uses Identity Verification for certify the identity of an actor via validation of a certification file in verify counterpart identity.

steps.title: Use protected payment flow
keyFacts: Protected payment escrows buyer funds and moves the order through pay -> ship -> deliver -> release states, applied only in shippable goods.
Take-rate exists only here, so this flow is the bridge from free classifieds to transactional monetization.
painPoints: A stuck state transition (payment captured but funds not released after delivery) freezes both buyer and seller money.
Offering protected payment on pickup-only categories confuses users and depresses contact instead of lifting trust.

dependencies.name: Payment Platform
dependencies.description: Ability to have a generic payment that can be used across the actor domains.
dependencies.how: Uses Payment Platform for have a generic payment that can be used across the actor domains in use protected payment flow.

dependencies.name: Payment and Verification Providers
dependencies.description: Provide payment execution and trust verification.
dependencies.how: Relies on Payment and Verification Providers for payment execution and trust verification in use protected payment flow.

steps.title: Detect risky interaction
keyFacts: Fraud signals span the whole funnel: scam listings, off-platform-contact nudges, fake-payment and courier-fee schemes, and account takeover.
Detection must run in near real time on messaging and payment events to intervene before money or goods change hands.
painPoints: Over-aggressive blocking freezes legitimate buyers and sellers mid-deal and generates costly support and appeals.
Sophisticated scams that look like normal local deals slip through rules until a victim reports a loss.

dependencies.name: Fraud Detection
dependencies.description: Ability to automatically censor a classified
dependencies.how: Uses Fraud Detection for automatically censor a classified in detect risky interaction.

steps.title: Complete trusted transaction
keyFacts: Completion releases escrowed funds to the seller on confirmed delivery and closes buyer protection on the order.
A clean, disputeless completion is what converts a one-off protected purchase into repeat trusted use.
painPoints: Disputes (item not as described, not delivered) need a fair, evidence-based resolution or one party feels cheated and churns.
Slow refunds or unclear protection terms after a failed delivery do lasting damage to marketplace trust.
